what: HouseBets limbo game page: the rules panel text (English) and the constants and functions it is filled from, as shipped in the bundle the live page loads

rulesPanelEnglish.rulesPickTarget: Pick a target multiplier between {min}× and {max}×. The game draws a result between {rmin}× and {rmax}×.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesWinWhen: You win when the result is at least your target (compared to the cent). The payout is your stake × target.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesFreeRound: A 0.00 stake plays a free round — the game runs and no money moves.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesChanceFormula: Win chance = 99 ÷ target, in percent. Example: target 2.00× → 49.50% chance → pays 2× (profit = stake × 1).
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesRtpLine: RTP is 99% at every target; the house edge is 1%.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCapLine: The result can reach {cap}×; targets above it cannot be entered.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMaxWin: A round pays at most {cap}. A bet whose win would exceed the cap is refused — not reduced — and the maximum bet for the current multiplier is shown under the amount.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesAutoLine: Auto places a run of bets at your stake, with optional on-win and on-loss increases and stop-on-profit / stop-on-loss limits. Advanced lets a strategy decide each next bet from the last round. Instant runs up to {max} bets back to back and draws a profit line as each one settles. Every stop is checked after each settled bet.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesFairLine: Every result is derived from the server seed (its hash is published before the round), your client seed and the nonce. The derivation matches the public Limbo calculators — see the Provably Fair window to verify any round or try your own seeds.
